1
Nahi Sajjad Nu Bhulne Loko Safar Bazaran De.
Sir Nangay Wekhay Jis Ne Apne Pardah Daraan De.
Istaqbal Ich Lokaan Ne Galiyaan Khoob Sajaiyaan Ne.
Pairaan De Wich Aj V Ne Zakhm Oh Pathraan Kharaan De.

2
Masooma Zindana Taein Roz Tamachay Khandi Rayi.
Choon Salaan Di Zahra De Badlay Rang Rukhsaraan De.
Sanghaan Te Ne Sir Jehray Akbar, Asghar Jaye Bachray.
Hazaran Zakhm Ne Chehray Te Teraan Te Talwaraan De.

3
Zakhmi Talway Pairaan De Naal Janazay Chadraan De.
Peshi Peshi De Naal Ray Sab Lashay Dastaraan De.
Kofa Aakhaan Sham Kahwaan Akbar Ghurbat De Kayi Naa.
Abid Chali Salaan Tak Dard Kahey Darbaraan De.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, re
p = 'src/data/lyrics/nahi-sajjad-nu-bhulne-loko-safar-bazaran-de-lyrics-punjabi-2025-tajpoints-3fb9b16db43249cd7c26.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2]
_, front, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---',2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n',1)[1]
def stanzas(s):
    return [x.splitlines() for x in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in s.strip().splitlines()))]
assert [[l.lower().rstrip('.') for l in b] for b in stanzas(old)] == [[l.lower() for l in b] for b in stanzas(roman)]
assert [b[0] for b in stanzas(body)] == ['۱','۲','۳']
assert [len(b) for b in stanzas(body)] == [5,5,5]
print('Verified 12 corresponding verses across three stanzas and preserved Roman wording.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, with sentence case and verse-ending periods removed. Verified that both editions have three numbered stanzas of four verses. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the missing-source tag.

The Roman readings “Choon,” “Kharaan,” and “jaye” are ambiguous. I rendered them as چوں، کھراں، and جئے, respectively.
